packages.label: שֶׁפַע אֱלֹקִי וּמַקִּיפִין — הָאוֹר הָאֱלֹקִי הַסּוֹבֵב
packages.label_en: Divine Influx and Surrounding Lights — The Encircling Divine Light
packages.reason: All nodes in this package share a single essential nature: they are names or vessels for the same divine reality — the transcendent divine influx (שפע אלקי) that surrounds and exceeds human comprehension. שפע אלקי, רוח הקדש, מקיפין, קדש, חפה, קדושין, סכה — all are synonymous expressions of this surrounding holy light. The 7 candles/clouds/feast-days and their equivalents (שבעת הנרות, שבעה עננים/עננים הנ"ל, שמן, שבעת ימי המשתה, פה-חטמא-עינין-אדנין) are the channels through which this influx reaches the human brain. ישראל = התגלות המחין = המשכת אור הפנים = שפע אלקי forms a single identity chain. עתיקא, קדם/פנים (the 'front' = the divine face-presence), לבוש/חשמל (the garment-as-protective-layer of the internalized מקיפין) all share this nature — they are aspects of the transcendent divine surrounding-light as it approaches the human. This is the dominant positive cluster of the entire Torah.
nodes: פה ותרין נקבא חטמא ותרין עינין ותרין אדנין

merge_notes.reason: CC7 (לבוש=חשמל) merged into Package A because the garment/חשמל is explicitly the protective form of the internalized מקיפין. 'מלבוש' in gematria = 'חשמל' and the חשמל repels all destroyers. The garment IS the מקיף made into an external shell — it shares the essential nature of surrounding/protecting light, not a cause-effect relationship. Belongs with the שפע-אלקי/מקיפין cluster.

CC9 (קדם=פנים) merged into Package A because קדם (= 'before' = front) is an explicit synonym for פנים (face/presence of God) throughout Torah #21. The text equates: 'שכל שבא בלא הקדמות הוא קדם, בשם פנים' = שפע אלקי. קדם/פנים share the essential nature of the divine face-light = שפע אלקי. Not a cause, but the same reality.

packages.label: הַמֹּחַ וּמְנוֹרַת אֵבְרֵי הָרֹאשׁ
packages.label_en: The Brain and the Menorah of the Head's Organs
packages.reason: All nodes in this package share a single essential nature: they are the brain/intellect (מח/מחין) and its organs — the seven lights of the head-menorah through which divine influx enters. The מנורה IS the head/brain (רישא); the four pairs of organs (פה-חטם-עינין-אדנין) each have their own dimension of brain-light (מח הנאמר אצל X). The scripture verses paired with each organ ('ראש דברך אמת' = מח אצל פה; 'ראשית חכמה יראת ה' = מח אצל חטם; 'הוכח לחכם ויאהבך' = מח אצל אדנין; 'ותפקחנה עיני שניהם' = מח אצל עינין) are the bechina of each organ's brain-dimension. יראת שמים = חטם because 'והריחו ביראת ה'' — they share the essential nature of the organ of awe. כונה = מחין because 'הקול מעורר הכוונה, הינו המחין' — intention IS the brain. זעיר אנפין = all human-attainable wisdom — these wisdoms are the inner face of the brain as vessel. All are aspects of the same domain: the human intellect as the seven-branched menorah of the head.

packages.label: עִבּוּר, הֶעְלֵם וְלֵדַת הַמֹּחִין
packages.label_en: Gestation, Concealment and the Birth of the Intellect
packages.reason: All nodes in this package share a single essential nature: they are states, forms, and actors of the concealment-then-revelation cycle of the intellect. העלם = עבור (concealment = gestation) — these are two names for the same state. לא אתגליא = העלם (not-yet-revealed = concealment). יעקב = עבור — Jacob in the womb grasping his brother is the bechina of the intellect in its pre-birth, latent state. 'כשאדם לומד תורה ואין מבין חדוש' = עבור — Torah without new insight IS the gestation state. גלוי = לדה — revelation = birth, the moment the latent becomes manifest. The birth-cry of the woman in labor = the prayer-cry during intellectual gestation; both share the essential nature of the voice that labors toward birth. This package is neutral — it describes a universal structural condition (intellect oscillating between hidden and revealed states) that applies to both holy and mundane contexts.
